data.name: Unavailable
data.value: This run has no saved permission classification.

data.name: Invalid
data.value: Saved permission classification could not be read.

data.name: RawAvailable
data.value: Captured permission entries remain available; risk classification is unavailable.

data.name: Hidden
data.value: Saved classifications are available. Turn on Highlight risky permissions to show them.

data.name: Unknown
data.value: {0} rights could not be classified. They are not reported as safe.

data.name: UnknownDetail
data.value: Each right retains the saved reason why it could not be classified.

data.name: Dangerous
data.value: Entries with at least one saved right classified Dangerous. This is not proof that a particular account can take control.

data.name: Combination
data.value: Entries whose highest saved risk is In combination. The necessary combined rights or conditions are not established by this classification.

data.name: Control
data.value: Control totals are not counted in this strip. Read the saved control results separately.

data.name: Findings
data.value: Finding totals are not counted in this strip. Read the Findings section for saved results or why they are unavailable.

data.name: Empty
data.value: The captured permission list contains no entries. This alone does not establish effective access.

data.name: Order
data.value: The captured permission list was not in canonical order. Entries retain their captured order within each principal.

data.name: Incomplete
data.value: The captured permission list is incomplete. Missing entries may change access; this view does not establish effective access.

data.name: HighlightHelp
data.value: Shows saved per-right permission-risk classifications, not proof of effective access or completed takeover. It marks and never hides: every entry stays on the list.
